events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Vincent Trocheck scored the shootout winner and Igor Shesterkin made 31 saves and the New York Rangers rallied to defeat the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trocheck scores shootout winner as Rangers edge Penguins 3-2

headlines.description: — Travis Konecny opened the scoring in the third period and set up Jaime Drysdale's goal, Dan Vladar made 26 saves and the Philadelphia Flyers beat the Boston Bruins 3-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Travis Konecny, Dan Vladar lead Flyers past Bruins, 3-1

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Shakir Mukhamadullin broke a tie midway through the third period and the San Jose Sharks snapped a five-game winless streak by beating the Edmonton Oilers 5-4 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharks beat the Oilers 5-4 to snap a 5-game winless streak

events.name: New Jersey Devils at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Jacob Markstrom made 25 saves, Timo Meier and Dougie Hamilton had second-period goals and the New Jersey Devils beat the St. Louis Blues 3-1 on Saturday to end a five-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Markstrom makes 25 saves, Devils beat Blues 3-1 to end 5-game skid

events.name: New York Islanders at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Simon Holmstrom scored 1:50 into overtime as the New York Islanders beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-3 on Saturday night for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Holmstrom's OT goal gives Islanders 4-3 win over Blue Jackets and extends winning streak to 4

headlines.description: — Cale Makar scored two goals, Gavin Brindley had the go-ahead score early in the third period and the Colorado Avalanche beat the Chicago Blackhawks 3-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Makar scores 2 goals as NHL-leading Avalanche beat Blackhawks 3-1

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Drake Batherson and Dylan Cozens each scored twice and the Ottawa Senators beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Batherson, Cozens each score twice in the Senators' 5-2 win over the Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored two first-period goals to help propel the Montreal Canadiens to a 6-2 win over the Washington Capitals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield scores 2 in the first period as the Canadiens beat the Capitals 6-2

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Josh Norris scored twice, Rasmus Dahlin had a goal and two assists and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 6-2 on Saturday night for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sabres beat the Lightning 6-2 for their 3rd straight victory

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Shayne Gostisbehere had a goal and two assists to lead the Carolina Hurricanes to their fifth straight win, 5-2 over the Detroit Red Wings on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurricanes continue hot streak with 5-2 win over Detroit

events.name: Calgary Flames at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Anton Forsberg made 29 saves, Alex Laferriere scored in the second period and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Calgary Flames 2-0 on Saturday night to end a five-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsberg makes 29 saves, the Kings beat the Flames 2-0 to end a 5-game losing streak

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson scored 1:47 into overtime, lifting the Dallas Stars to a 3-2 comeback victory over the Nashville Predators on Saturday night for their eighth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robertson’s overtime goal caps Stars’ 3-2 comeback over Predators for 8th straight win

headlines.description: — Jordan Eberle scored twice and added an assist as the Seattle Kraken beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eberle scores twice as Kraken defeat Canucks 5-1
